proposed_decisions: \ulcorner\alpha\urcorner is used as the code number of a propositional formula (binary numeral 1w for the def:p02-sat-taut encoding w), scoped to sec:p02-w02-p02-017-finite-input-scope; same role family as the P5 Goedel-number row, different coding. Record as a scoped row.
P_{\N} names the source alphabet {p_n : n in N} in editorial text because \Prop is restoration-only; scoped to sec:p02-w02-p02-017-finite-input-scope.
\mathbin{\dot{-}} is cutoff subtraction (same meaning as the P12 har-prime row), not the P8 Brouwerian difference; scoped to the annex section.
The annex uses F for the partial function x -> varphi_x(x); the filter F_Gamma of sec:p02-free-boolean-completeness is a different object in a different section. Local annex scope only.

\mathsf U (Kleene normal-form output function, thm:p04-kleene-normal-form) and the universal function U(e,x) of thm:universal-computation share a letter in the inherited sources; the annex names the latter only once, with an explicit disambiguation.
